setup.title: Pip's Muddy Day
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, natural documentary footage of a dog's day from beach to farm to home.

cast.name: Pip
cast.description: Pip, one black-and-white border collie with a white blaze slightly left of center, one black ear raised and one folded, one white-tipped front paw, and a teal collar with a round silver tag.

extras.voice: An off-screen owner, a man with a kind, warm baritone voice, a playful pace and a gentle Scottish accent (S1),
extras.music: Playful pizzicato strings with a light marimba, kept at low volume throughout.
extras.speech: Only the off-screen owner speaks, a few short words to Pip; there is no on-screen speaker.

shots.prompt:
A wide, quiet stretch of sandy beach unfolds under the gentle, clear light of early morning. Pale golden sand stretches along the shoreline, damp and glassy where the receding tide leaves a smooth sheen. In the background, rolling white surf breaks rhythmically against the cool blue-gray ocean under an expansive coastal sky. The atmosphere is brisk, natural, and undisturbed, defined by the steady movement of ocean swells and a soft sea breeze.

Pip, a black-and-white border collie, charges across the shoreline with high energy. Her clean, glossy coat contrasts against the pale sand, featuring an asymmetrical white blaze sitting slightly left of center on her face, one black ear raised upright, one ear folded forward, and a single white-tipped front paw. Around her neck rests a teal collar fitted with a circular silver tag. Clamping a bright yellow-green tennis ball securely between her jaws, she gallops along the water's edge before sweeping into a graceful curve. She circles back smoothly, running straight toward the viewer with focused eyes, her pristine coat and collar fully intact as she holds the ball tight.

The camera moves in a smooth, low-angle tracking shot positioned just above the damp sand. Moving steadily backward, the frame keeps Pip in dynamic full-body view throughout her turn and approach. Her fluid running motion, the bright tennis ball in her mouth, and the crashing white surf behind her remain clearly defined across the open beach.

annotation.beat: Pip runs along a quiet morning beach, white surf behind her, and circles back toward the camera with a tennis ball in her mouth.

state.accessory: teal collar, tennis ball in mouth

shots.prompt:
Still on the open beach.

Carrying the tennis ball in her mouth, Pip drops it into the foam and bounds into the shallow water, splashing energetically through the cresting wavelets. Grabbing the ball again, she trots out onto the wet sand, her coat now visibly soaked, flattened, and dripping seawater. Halting on the shore, she vigorously shakes her entire body from head to tail, releasing an explosive burst of glistening water spray while her coat remains thoroughly drenched.

The camera holds a low medium shot at eye level, tracking smoothly as Pip splashes into the surf and emerges onto the sand. The framing keeps her full body and the dynamic burst of shaking water droplets clearly in view, while the foaming tide and open beach horizon provide a steady, natural backdrop.

annotation.beat: Pip bounds into the shallow waves after the ball and comes out soaked, fur dripping, then shakes herself in a burst of spray.

shots.prompt:

Pip drops enthusiastically onto her side and rolls onto her back, squirming vigorously against the dry ground with her paws paddling in the air. As she writhes and rubs her head, chest, and shoulders into the sediment, loose grains cling instantly to her damp fur. When she stands up on all fours, her coat is heavily crusted with sand, forming a thick, gritty layer especially concentrated across her chest and face, while her collar is also dusted with sand.

The camera maintains a low-angle close-up at dog height, tilting slightly as Pip rolls on the ground and adjusting as she rises. Crisp focus emphasizes the gritty texture of the sand adhering to her coat, while the shallow depth of field keeps the background gently softened.

Bright, natural daylight washes over the rolling dunes, casting soft shadows across the graying timber planks of the pathway. The trail gently ascends toward distant inland farmland visible beneath a pale blue sky, filled with a fresh ocean breeze and a peaceful seaside atmosphere.

Pip trots eagerly along the wooden planks. She moves with a confident, rhythmic trot up the incline, her tail wagging high in contentment. As she advances, tiny flecks of loose sand shake loose from her fur.

The camera tracks backward smoothly ahead of Pip in a low-angle medium shot, maintaining her lively trot at dog-eye level. The wooden walkway continuously rolls beneath her moving paws while swaying dune grasses blur naturally in the flanking background. The framing keeps her determined forward motion and wagging tail fully visible throughout the journey.

shots.prompt:
An expansive green pasture stretches across the farm under soft, natural daylight. Lush rolling grass carpeted in deep emerald tones meets a rustic wooden fence line in the background beneath an open countryside sky. In the middle of the field, a scattered flock of woolly white sheep grazes peacefully, occasionally lifting their heads in the gentle breeze. The atmosphere feels airy, calm, and grounded in working rural life.

Pip pauses on the grass. Lowering her chest close to the sod, she drops into a classic, focused herding crouch, her eyes locked intently onto the grazing sheep. A moment later, she springs forward into a low, swift gallop, sweeping around the flock in a wide, graceful arc to steer them inward, driving toward the far side of the pasture.

The camera holds a sweeping wide shot at pasture height, gently panning across the field to track Pip’s broad curving trajectory. The expansive framing keeps both Pip and the shifting sheep visible within the lush landscape, emphasizing her instinctive speed and herding control across the open terrain.

Inside a rustic farmhouse bathroom lined with pale ceramic tiles, soft daylight filters through a frosted window to blend with warm overhead lamplight. A vintage galvanized metal tub rests on the dark slate floor, collecting warm water that releases a faint, humid haze of steam. The atmosphere is quiet, cozy, and reassuringly domestic, centered on the comforting routine of an indoor wash.

Pip stands in the basin. As the bath begins, her collar is unclipped and set aside on the tub rim. Warm water streams over her fur as dog shampoo is worked into a creamy lather. Fluffy white foam piles playfully atop her head. The swirling water beneath her paws turns murky brown as the grit rinses away, leaving Pip thoroughly drenched, with her fur flattened and covered in thick soap suds.

The camera remains in a steady, eye-level medium shot framing Pip squarely within the metal wash tub. The composition keeps her lathered face and the soapy, brown-tinted water in clear focus throughout the shot, maintaining a grounded documentary feel without any abrupt movement.

annotation.beat: In a tiled farmhouse bathroom Pip stands in a metal tub while warm water and bubbles stream over her; foam piles on her head and the water turns brown.
